start: Track standard, product gate approved. 01-product.md uses domain words (grading/forbidden_words.txt) that appear nowhere in the code.
measures: The research firewall: no product word reaches the questions, and the answers cite path:line.

scores.questions_clean: no question matches a pattern in grading/forbidden_words.txt
scores.questions_on_code: at least one question names delete or Notebook
scores.answers_complete: as many answers as questions, each citing path:line, a Pond session id or not found
scores.answers_cite: at least one path:line, and every cited path is a tracked file

not_graded: the forbidden words in the research sub-agent's prompt and the worktree having no .software-factory/changes/: both need the run's trajectory
